observations: Photo 0 shows a rectangular solar panel with a white frame and dark photovoltaic cells arranged in a grid.
The panel is leaning against a corrugated metal wall, with a concrete block stack behind it.
The panel has a watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' across the center.
Text at the bottom of the photo reads '23mm 6/18 1/40s ISO50', likely indicating panel dimensions and quality standard.
No visible damage or cracks on the surface in the photo.
The panel appears to be outdoors, with natural daylight and some dust or dirt on the surface.

risks.risk: The panel may be damaged or have reduced efficiency due to age or exposure, even if not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel's surface showing any cracks, discoloration, or hot spots, and a photo of the backside to check for internal damage or wiring issues.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially lower efficiency or non-functional

risks.risk: The panel may not be 350W or 60 cells as claimed, or may be counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing the brand, model, wattage, and cell count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified specification, possibly lower wattage or fewer cells

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have degraded performance due to prior use.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the panel connected to a multimeter or load, demonstrating output under sunlight.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back of the panel showing the nameplate with brand, model, wattage, and cell count.
Close-up photo of the panel's surface to check for cracks, discoloration, or damage.
Photo or video of the panel under sunlight connected to a multimeter or load to verify output.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
